digest.component_or_area: Jira DC readiness and provisioning harness
propositions: The harness and probe both gate on serverInfo 200 but never verify that required custom fields are registered, creating a timing window where the instance appears ready but fields are absent.
A system-only field inventory (zero customfield_* entries) indicates the instance is not yet ready to run tests, but this state is not distinguished from a degraded image in current error messages.
The two readiness gates (harness workflow and probe script) have diverged after partial fixes, making them susceptible to independent drift and conflicting failure modes.

The readiness check must poll /rest/api/2/field for required field names under a bounded budget and report the observed inventory on timeout, not misattribute delayed field registration to image degradation.
Moving the field-wait gate from session setup to _assert_project_capabilities is necessary because GreenHopper provisions Epic fields only after the first Jira Software project is created.
